name: Moo pony
tips: `apt moo` is an old Debian joke built into apt: it draws a cow and asks if you have mooed today.
Easter eggs are jokes hidden by developers. You find them by reading and trying: that's how you learn a tool.
`apt` installs, updates and removes packages on Debian and Ubuntu. Changing the system needs `sudo`.
personal: Have you mooed today? I have.
Why did the pony moo? To confuse the cow!
